trialLogs.promptData:
# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "チームメンバーの不満を聞いてるんだけど、誰が何に不満持ってるか整理できてない。まとめて対策考えたい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to チームメンバーの不満を聞いてるんだけど、誰が何に不満持ってるか整理できてない。まとめて対策考えたい", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- mind_map_0.nodes → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- card_sorting_0.categories → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- card_sorting_0.uncategorized → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

# Input Context

## User Concern
チームメンバーの不満を聞いてるんだけど、誰が何に不満持ってるか整理できてない。まとめて対策考えたい

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. mind_map - チームメンバーの不満情報を中心トピックから関連付けて発散的に可視化し、誰が何に不満を持っているか漏れなく洗い出す
Purpose: 不満や問題点の全体像を広げて洗い出す
Target: チームメンバーごとの不満内容
Ports:
mind_map (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: centralTopic (string)
  OUT: nodes (object[])
  OUT: connections (object[])
  OUT: depth (number)

### Organize Section
1. card_sorting - 発散フェーズで作った不満点カードをカテゴリごとに整理し、テーマや原因別に構造化する
Purpose: 不満内容をテーマごとに分類し整理する
Target: 不満項目のカテゴリ化
Ports:
card_sorting (complexity: 0.4):
  IN: cards (object[])
  OUT: categories (object)
  OUT: uncategorized (object[])

### Converge Section
1. priority_slider_grid - 整理された不満内容を優先度付けし、緊急対応すべき課題を抽出する
Purpose: 課題の優先順位を決定する
Target: 対応順序の決定
Ports:
priority_slider_grid (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: items (object[])
  OUT: priorities (object[])
  OUT: ranking (string[])

## Widget Definitions (with generationHints - IMPORTANT)
{
  "diverge": [
    {
      "id": "mind_map",
      "name": "マインドマップ",
      "description": "中心トピックから放射状にアイデアを展開。",
      "complexity": 0.5,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "centralTopic",
          "dataType": "string",
          "description": "中心トピック",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "nodes",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "マインドマップのノード"
        },
        {
          "id": "connections",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "ノード間の接続"
        },
        {
          "id": "depth",
          "dataType": "number",
          "description": "最大の深さ"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "organize": [
    {
      "id": "card_sorting",
      "name": "カードソート",
      "description": "カードをカテゴリにドラッグ&ドロップで分類。",
      "complexity": 0.4,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "cards",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "ソートするカードリスト",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "categories",
          "dataType": "object",
          "description": "カテゴリごとのカード配置"
        },
        {
          "id": "uncategorized",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "未分類のカード"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "converge": [
    {
      "id": "priority_slider_grid",
      "name": "優先度スライダー",
      "description": "複数の項目に対してスライダーで優先度を設定。",
      "complexity": 0.3,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "items",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "優先度を設定する項目リスト",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "priorities",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "優先度情報 {id: string, label: string, priority: number}"
        },
        {
          "id": "ranking",
          "dataType": "string[]",
          "description": "優先度順のID配列"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}

## ORS Data Structure
{
  "version": "5.0",
  "planMetadata": {
    "concernText": "チームメンバーの不満を聞いてるんだけど、誰が何に不満持ってるか整理できてない。まとめて対策考えたい",
    "bottleneckType": "thought",
    "sections": [
      "diverge",
      "organize",
      "converge"
    ]
  },
  "entities": [
    {
      "id": "concern",
      "type": "concern",
      "attributes": [
        {
          "name": "text",
          "structuralType": "SVAL",
          "valueType": "string",
          "description": "ユーザーの元の悩みテキスト"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "dependencyGraph": {
    "dependencies": [],
    "metadata": {
      "version": "5.0",
      "generatedAt": 1765623661154
    }
  },
  "metadata": {
    "generatedAt": 1765623661154,
    "llmModel": "fallback",
    "sessionId": "batch-772ca8db-4545-405b-a707-4bc221153420-121",
    "concernText": "チームメンバーの不満を聞いてるんだけど、誰が何に不満持ってるか整理できてない。まとめて対策考えたい",
    "bottleneckType": "thought",
    "sections": [
      "diverge",
      "organize",
      "converge"
    ]
  }
}

# Output JSON Structure

Generate valid JSON with:
- version: "5.0"
- sessionId: "batch-772ca8db-4545-405b-a707-4bc221153420-121"
- stage: "plan"
- sections: { diverge, organize, converge } - each with header and widgets array
- reactiveBindings: { bindings: [...] } - widget connections (REQUIRED when enableReactivity=true)
- layout: { type: "sectioned", sectionGap: 24, sectionOrder: ["diverge", "organize", "converge"] }

## Widget Structure
{
  "id": "widgetType_sectionIndex" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0"),
  "component": "widgetType",
  "position": 0,
  "layout": "full",
  "config": { /* include generatedValue here if widget has generationHints */ },
  "dataBindings": [{ "portId": "...", "entityAttribute": "entity.attribute", "direction": "in|out" }],
  "metadata": { "purpose": "..." }
}

# Rules Reference

## updateMode Selection
- "realtime": Both widgets have complexity <= 0.3
- "debounced" (300ms): Either widget has complexity > 0.3

## relationship.type Selection
- "passthrough": Same data structure (e.g., cards → cards)
- "javascript": Need transformation (e.g., categories → items)

# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "今日やることをタイムラインに並べて効率よく進めたい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

Example for brainstorm_cards:

  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to 今日やることをタイムラインに並べて効率よく進めたい", "isGenerated": true },

    ],

}

}

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

- mind_map_0.connections → dependency_mapping_0.nodes (diverge→organize)

- mind_map_0.connections → timeline_slider_1.events (diverge→organize)

}

# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "友人関係を見直したい。誰と付き合いを続けるか、距離を置くか、整理して優先度つけたい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to 友人関係を見直したい。誰と付き合いを続けるか、距離を置くか、整理して優先度つけたい", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- mind_map_0.nodes → matrix_placement_0.items (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.nodes → matrix_placement_0.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → matrix_placement_0.items (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → matrix_placement_0.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → matrix_placement_0.items (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → matrix_placement_0.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- matrix_placement_0.placements → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):

  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

# Input Context

友人関係を見直したい。誰と付き合いを続けるか、距離を置くか、整理して優先度つけたい

# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "読みたい本がたまりすぎた。どれから読むか優先度決めて、計画的に消化したい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to 読みたい本がたまりすぎた。どれから読むか優先度決めて、計画的に消化したい", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- mind_map_0.nodes → matrix_placement_0.items (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.nodes → matrix_placement_0.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → matrix_placement_0.items (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → matrix_placement_0.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → matrix_placement_0.items (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → matrix_placement_0.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- matrix_placement_0.placements → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- matrix_placement_0.quadrantCounts → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

# Input Context

## User Concern
読みたい本がたまりすぎた。どれから読むか優先度決めて、計画的に消化したい

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. mind_map - 読みたい本のテーマや目的を中心に、関連するジャンルや関心を広げることで全体像を把握する
Purpose: 読書候補を網羅的に洗い出し、関連性やジャンルを可視化する
Target: 読みたい本のリストと関連要素の抽出
Ports:
mind_map (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: centralTopic (string)
  OUT: nodes (object[])
  OUT: connections (object[])
  OUT: depth (number)

### Organize Section
1. matrix_placement - 2軸で本を評価し、優先度設定に役立つ構造化を行う
Purpose: 洗い出した本を興味と重要度の観点で分類・整理する
Target: 発散した本リストを優先度決定に向けた位置づけへ変換
Ports:
matrix_placement (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: items (object[])
  IN: axisLabels (object)
  OUT: placements (object[])
  OUT: quadrantCounts (object)

### Converge Section
1. priority_slider_grid - カテゴリ別に整理された本に具体的な優先度スコアを付与する
Purpose: 整理結果をもとに実際に読む順番を決定する
Target: 読書順序と優先度の明確化
Ports:
priority_slider_grid (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: items (object[])
  OUT: priorities (object[])
  OUT: ranking (string[])

## Widget Definitions (with generationHints - IMPORTANT)
{
  "diverge": [
    {
      "id": "mind_map",
      "name": "マインドマップ",
      "description": "中心トピックから放射状にアイデアを展開。",
      "complexity": 0.5,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "centralTopic",
          "dataType": "string",
          "description": "中心トピック",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "nodes",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "マインドマップのノード"
        },
        {
          "id": "connections",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "ノード間の接続"
        },
        {
          "id": "depth",
          "dataType": "number",
          "description": "最大の深さ"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "organize": [
    {
      "id": "matrix_placement",
      "name": "マトリクス配置",
      "description": "2軸のマトリクス上にアイテムを配置し、位置関係を可視化。",
      "complexity": 0.5,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "items",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "配置するアイテムリスト",
          "required": false
        },
        {
          "id": "axisLabels",
          "dataType": "object",
          "description": "軸のラベル {xAxis: {low: string, high: string}, yAxis: {low: string, high: string}}",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "placements",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "アイテムの配置情報 {id: string, x: number, y: number}"
        },
        {
          "id": "quadrantCounts",
          "dataType": "object",
          "description": "各象限のアイテム数"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "converge": [
    {
      "id": "priority_slider_grid",
      "name": "優先度スライダー",
      "description": "複数の項目に対してスライダーで優先度を設定。",
      "complexity": 0.3,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "items",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "優先度を設定する項目リスト",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "priorities",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "優先度情報 {id: string, label: string, priority: number}"
        },
        {
          "id": "ranking",
          "dataType": "string[]",
          "description": "優先度順のID配列"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}

## ORS Data Structure
{
  "version": "5.0",
  "planMetadata": {
    "concernText": "読みたい本がたまりすぎた。どれから読むか優先度決めて、計画的に消化したい",
    "bottleneckType": "thought",
    "sections": [
      "diverge",
      "organize",
      "converge"
    ]
  },
  "entities": [
    {
      "id": "concern",
      "type": "concern",
      "attributes": [
        {
          "name": "text",
          "structuralType": "SVAL",
          "valueType": "string",
          "description": "ユーザーの元の悩みテキスト"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "dependencyGraph": {
    "dependencies": [],
    "metadata": {
      "version": "5.0",
      "generatedAt": 1765623768083
    }
  },
  "metadata": {
    "generatedAt": 1765623768083,
    "llmModel": "fallback",
    "sessionId": "batch-772ca8db-4545-405b-a707-4bc221153420-131",
    "concernText": "読みたい本がたまりすぎた。どれから読むか優先度決めて、計画的に消化したい",
    "bottleneckType": "thought",
    "sections": [
      "diverge",
      "organize",
      "converge"
    ]
  }
}

# Output JSON Structure

Generate valid JSON with:
- version: "5.0"
- sessionId: "batch-772ca8db-4545-405b-a707-4bc221153420-131"
- stage: "plan"
- sections: { diverge, organize, converge } - each with header and widgets array
- reactiveBindings: { bindings: [...] } - widget connections (REQUIRED when enableReactivity=true)
- layout: { type: "sectioned", sectionGap: 24, sectionOrder: ["diverge", "organize", "converge"] }

## Widget Structure
{
  "id": "widgetType_sectionIndex" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0"),
  "component": "widgetType",
  "position": 0,
  "layout": "full",
  "config": { /* include generatedValue here if widget has generationHints */ },
  "dataBindings": [{ "portId": "...", "entityAttribute": "entity.attribute", "direction": "in|out" }],
  "metadata": { "purpose": "..." }
}

# Rules Reference

## updateMode Selection
- "realtime": Both widgets have complexity <= 0.3
- "debounced" (300ms): Either widget has complexity > 0.3

## relationship.type Selection
- "passthrough": Same data structure (e.g., cards → cards)
- "javascript": Need transformation (e.g., categories → items)

## updateMode Selection
- "realtime": Both widgets have complexity <= 0.3
- "debounced" (300ms): Either widget has complexity > 0.3

- "passthrough": Same data structure (e.g., cards → cards)
- "javascript": Need transformation (e.g., categories → items)

trialLogs.promptData:
# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "タスクを整理して時系列に並べて優先度も決めたい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to タスクを整理して時系列に並べて優先度も決めたい", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- mind_map_0.nodes → dependency_mapping_0.nodes (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → dependency_mapping_0.nodes (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → dependency_mapping_0.nodes (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.nodes → timeline_slider_1.events (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → timeline_slider_1.events (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → timeline_slider_1.events (diverge→organize)
- dependency_mapping_0.edges → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- dependency_mapping_0.criticalPath → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- dependency_mapping_0.hasLoop → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- timeline_slider_1.timeline → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- timeline_slider_1.currentPosition → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

# Input Context

## User Concern
タスクを整理して時系列に並べて優先度も決めたい

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. mind_map - タスクや関連情報を広く洗い出し、連想的に展開して全体像を可視化することで、思考の発散を促す。
Purpose: タスクに関する情報を最大限発散し、関連や構造のヒントを得る。
Target: タスクの全容と関連性
Ports:
mind_map (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: centralTopic (string)
  OUT: nodes (object[])
  OUT: connections (object[])
  OUT: depth (number)

### Organize Section
1. dependency_mapping - タスク間の順序や依存関係を明確にし、時系列整理の基盤を作る。
2. timeline_slider - 依存関係と計画を反映し、タスクを時間軸に沿って配置する。
Purpose: 発散した情報を時系列と依存関係に基づいて整理し、計画可能な形に構造化する。
Target: タスクとその順序・スケジュール
Ports:
dependency_mapping (complexity: 0.7):
  IN: nodes (object[])
  OUT: edges (object[])
  OUT: criticalPath (string[])
  OUT: hasLoop (boolean)

timeline_slider (complexity: 0.4):
  IN: events (object[])
  OUT: timeline (object[])
  OUT: currentPosition (number)

### Converge Section
1. priority_slider_grid - 各タスクの優先度を定量的に設定し、実行順や重要度を明確化する。
Purpose: タスク実施順や重要度を具体的に決定し、行動計画に落とし込む。
Target: 優先度付きタスクリスト
Ports:
priority_slider_grid (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: items (object[])
  OUT: priorities (object[])
  OUT: ranking (string[])

## Widget Definitions (with generationHints - IMPORTANT)
{
  "diverge": [
    {
      "id": "mind_map",
      "name": "マインドマップ",
      "description": "中心トピックから放射状にアイデアを展開。",
      "complexity": 0.5,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "centralTopic",
          "dataType": "string",
          "description": "中心トピック",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "nodes",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "マインドマップのノード"
        },
        {
          "id": "connections",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "ノード間の接続"
        },
        {
          "id": "depth",
          "dataType": "number",
          "description": "最大の深さ"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "organize": [
    {
      "id": "dependency_mapping",
      "name": "依存関係マップ",
      "description": "タスクや要素間の依存関係をノードとエッジで可視化。クリティカルパスや循環依存を自動検出。",
      "complexity": 0.7,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "nodes",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "ノードリスト。各ノードは {id: string, label: string, x?: number, y?: number} の形式。",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "edges",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "接続エッジリスト。各エッジは {sourceId: string, targetId: string, type: string} の形式。"
        },
        {
          "id": "criticalPath",
          "dataType": "string[]",
          "description": "クリティカルパス（最長依存チェーン）のノードID配列"
        },
        {
          "id": "hasLoop",
          "dataType": "boolean",
          "description": "循環依存が存在するかどうか"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "timeline_slider",
      "name": "タイムラインスライダー",
      "description": "時間軸に沿ってイベントや計画を配置。",
      "complexity": 0.4,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "events",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "イベントリスト",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "timeline",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "時系列に並んだイベント"
        },
        {
          "id": "currentPosition",
          "dataType": "number",
          "description": "現在のスライダー位置"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "converge": [
    {
      "id": "priority_slider_grid",
      "name": "優先度スライダー",
      "description": "複数の項目に対してスライダーで優先度を設定。",
      "complexity": 0.3,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "items",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "優先度を設定する項目リスト",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "priorities",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "優先度情報 {id: string, label: string, priority: number}"
        },
        {
          "id": "ranking",
          "dataType": "string[]",
          "description": "優先度順のID配列"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}

    "bottleneckType": "thought",

      "diverge",

      "converge"
    ]
  }
}

# Output JSON Structure

Generate valid JSON with:
- version: "5.0"
- sessionId: "batch-772ca8db-4545-405b-a707-4bc221153420-141"
- stage: "plan"
- sections: { diverge, organize, converge } - each with header and widgets array
- reactiveBindings: { bindings: [...] } - widget connections (REQUIRED when enableReactivity=true)
- layout: { type: "sectioned", sectionGap: 24, sectionOrder: ["diverge", "organize", "converge"] }

## Widget Structure
{
  "id": "widgetType_sectionIndex" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0"),
  "component": "widgetType",
  "position": 0,
  "layout": "full",
  "config": { /* include generatedValue here if widget has generationHints */ },
  "dataBindings": [{ "portId": "...", "entityAttribute": "entity.attribute", "direction": "in|out" }],
  "metadata": { "purpose": "..." }
}

# Rules Reference

## updateMode Selection
- "realtime": Both widgets have complexity <= 0.3
- "debounced" (300ms): Either widget has complexity > 0.3

## relationship.type Selection
- "passthrough": Same data structure (e.g., cards → cards)
- "javascript": Need transformation (e.g., categories → items)

# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "チーム内の問題を解決したい。課題を出して、関係性を整理して、優先度つけて対策を立てたい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to チーム内の問題を解決したい。課題を出して、関係性を整理して、優先度つけて対策を立てたい", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- mind_map_0.nodes → dependency_mapping_0.nodes (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → dependency_mapping_0.nodes (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → dependency_mapping_0.nodes (diverge→organize)
- dependency_mapping_0.edges → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- dependency_mapping_0.criticalPath → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- dependency_mapping_0.hasLoop → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

# Input Context

## User Concern
チーム内の問題を解決したい。課題を出して、関係性を整理して、優先度つけて対策を立てたい

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. mind_map - チーム内の課題や要素を中心トピックから関連付けて広げ、関係性の全体像を把握するため
Purpose: 課題や関連要素の洗い出しと関係性の探索
Target: チーム内の問題点や関連する要因の網羅的把握
Ports:
mind_map (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: centralTopic (string)
  OUT: nodes (object[])
  OUT: connections (object[])
  OUT: depth (number)

### Organize Section
1. dependency_mapping - 課題や要素間の依存関係を可視化し、解決の順序やボトルネックを特定するため
Purpose: 課題の整理と構造化、依存関係の把握
Target: 課題間の関係性と優先順序の前提となる構造
Ports:
dependency_mapping (complexity: 0.7):
  IN: nodes (object[])
  OUT: edges (object[])
  OUT: criticalPath (string[])
  OUT: hasLoop (boolean)

### Converge Section
1. priority_slider_grid - 依存関係から得られた課題リストに対して優先度を設定し、収束させるため
Purpose: 重要な課題に優先度を付け、解決順序を確定
Target: 優先的に取り組む課題セット
Ports:
priority_slider_grid (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: items (object[])
  OUT: priorities (object[])
  OUT: ranking (string[])

## Widget Definitions (with generationHints - IMPORTANT)
{
  "diverge": [
    {
      "id": "mind_map",
      "name": "マインドマップ",
      "description": "中心トピックから放射状にアイデアを展開。",
      "complexity": 0.5,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "centralTopic",
          "dataType": "string",
          "description": "中心トピック",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "nodes",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "マインドマップのノード"
        },
        {
          "id": "connections",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "ノード間の接続"
        },
        {
          "id": "depth",
          "dataType": "number",
          "description": "最大の深さ"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "organize": [
    {
      "id": "dependency_mapping",
      "name": "依存関係マップ",
      "description": "タスクや要素間の依存関係をノードとエッジで可視化。クリティカルパスや循環依存を自動検出。",
      "complexity": 0.7,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "nodes",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "ノードリスト。各ノードは {id: string, label: string, x?: number, y?: number} の形式。",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "edges",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "接続エッジリスト。各エッジは {sourceId: string, targetId: string, type: string} の形式。"
        },
        {
          "id": "criticalPath",
          "dataType": "string[]",
          "description": "クリティカルパス（最長依存チェーン）のノードID配列"
        },
        {
          "id": "hasLoop",
          "dataType": "boolean",
          "description": "循環依存が存在するかどうか"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "converge": [
    {
      "id": "priority_slider_grid",
      "name": "優先度スライダー",
      "description": "複数の項目に対してスライダーで優先度を設定。",
      "complexity": 0.3,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "items",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "優先度を設定する項目リスト",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "priorities",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "優先度情報 {id: string, label: string, priority: number}"
        },
        {
          "id": "ranking",
          "dataType": "string[]",
          "description": "優先度順のID配列"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}

## ORS Data Structure
{
  "version": "5.0",
  "planMetadata": {
    "concernText": "チーム内の問題を解決したい。課題を出して、関係性を整理して、優先度つけて対策を立てたい",
    "bottleneckType": "thought",
    "sections": [
      "diverge",
      "organize",
      "converge"
    ]
  },
  "entities": [
    {
      "id": "concern",
      "type": "concern",
      "attributes": [
        {
          "name": "text",
          "structuralType": "SVAL",
          "valueType": "string",
          "description": "ユーザーの元の悩みテキスト"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "dependencyGraph": {
    "dependencies": [],
    "metadata": {
      "version": "5.0",
      "generatedAt": 1765623920423
    }
  },
  "metadata": {
    "generatedAt": 1765623920423,
    "llmModel": "fallback",
    "sessionId": "batch-772ca8db-4545-405b-a707-4bc221153420-145",
    "concernText": "チーム内の問題を解決したい。課題を出して、関係性を整理して、優先度つけて対策を立てたい",
    "bottleneckType": "thought",
    "sections": [
      "diverge",
      "organize",
      "converge"
    ]
  }
}

# Output JSON Structure

Generate valid JSON with:
- version: "5.0"
- sessionId: "batch-772ca8db-4545-405b-a707-4bc221153420-145"
- stage: "plan"
- sections: { diverge, organize, converge } - each with header and widgets array
- reactiveBindings: { bindings: [...] } - widget connections (REQUIRED when enableReactivity=true)
- layout: { type: "sectioned", sectionGap: 24, sectionOrder: ["diverge", "organize", "converge"] }

## Widget Structure
{
  "id": "widgetType_sectionIndex" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0"),
  "component": "widgetType",
  "position": 0,
  "layout": "full",
  "config": { /* include generatedValue here if widget has generationHints */ },
  "dataBindings": [{ "portId": "...", "entityAttribute": "entity.attribute", "direction": "in|out" }],
  "metadata": { "purpose": "..." }
}

# Rules Reference

## updateMode Selection
- "realtime": Both widgets have complexity <= 0.3
- "debounced" (300ms): Either widget has complexity > 0.3

## relationship.type Selection
- "passthrough": Same data structure (e.g., cards → cards)
- "javascript": Need transformation (e.g., categories → items)

## updateMode Selection

trialLogs.promptData:
# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "最近のストレスを根本から整理したい。まず今の感情を全部出して、原因を分類して、対処の優先度を決めて、最終的にどこから手をつけるか決めたい。感情的になりがちだから、段階的に冷静に進めたい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
[ ] emotion_palette: config.emotions (labels, 8 items)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to 最近のストレスを根本から整理したい。まず今の感情を全部出して、原因を分類して、対処の優先度を決めて、最終的にどこから手をつけるか決めたい。感情的になりがちだから、段階的に冷静に進めたい", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- emotion_palette_0.selectedEmotions → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- emotion_palette_0.dominantEmotion → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- emotion_palette_0.selectedEmotions → timeline_slider_1.events (diverge→organize)
- emotion_palette_0.dominantEmotion → timeline_slider_1.events (diverge→organize)
- card_sorting_0.categories → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- card_sorting_0.uncategorized → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- timeline_slider_1.timeline → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- timeline_slider_1.currentPosition → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

# Input Context

## User Concern
最近のストレスを根本から整理したい。まず今の感情を全部出して、原因を分類して、対処の優先度を決めて、最終的にどこから手をつけるか決めたい。感情的になりがちだから、段階的に冷静に進めたい

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. emotion_palette - 今の感情を体系的にすべて洗い出し、強度も可視化することで初期の感情的把握を行う
Purpose: 感情や思考を広げて可視化することで、ストレス要因を網羅的に把握する
Target: 感情とそれに付随するストレス要因の抽出
Ports:
emotion_palette (complexity: 0.3):

  OUT: selectedEmotions (object[])
  OUT: dominantEmotion (string)
  GENERATE: config.emotions

### Organize Section
1. card_sorting - 発散した感情や要因をカテゴリごとに分類し、構造化する
2. timeline_slider - 分類された要因を時系列に配置し、過去から現在への流れを把握する
Purpose: 要因をカテゴリ化し、計画的視点から時間的な配置も行う
Target: ストレス要因の分類と時間軸による整理
Ports:
card_sorting (complexity: 0.4):
  IN: cards (object[])
  OUT: categories (object)
  OUT: uncategorized (object[])

timeline_slider (complexity: 0.4):
  IN: events (object[])
  OUT: timeline (object[])
  OUT: currentPosition (number)

### Converge Section
1. priority_slider_grid - 整理された要因に優先度を付け、どこから対処するかの基準を数値化する
Purpose: 優先度を明確にし、行動計画の着手順序を決定する
Target: 行動対象となる要因の選定と順位付け
Ports:
priority_slider_grid (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: items (object[])
  OUT: priorities (object[])
  OUT: ranking (string[])

## Widget Definitions (with generationHints - IMPORTANT)

# Output JSON Structure

Generate valid JSON with:

- sessionId: "batch-772ca8db-4545-405b-a707-4bc221153420-149"
- stage: "plan"
- sections: { diverge, organize, converge } - each with header and widgets array
- reactiveBindings: { bindings: [...] } - widget connections (REQUIRED when enableReactivity=true)

- "debounced" (300ms): Either widget has complexity > 0.3

- "javascript": Need transformation (e.g., categories → items)

generatedData.rationale: ユーザーのボトルネックがthoughtのため、発散段階では網羅的な探索ができるmind_mapを選択し、その後分類を行うcard_sortingで整理。収束段階ではpriority_slider_gridで優先度付けし、最終的にstructured_summaryで結果を簡潔かつ体系的にまとめることで、全体を俯瞰しやすくする構成とした。各ステージのcomplexityは0.8以下に収まり、timingも早→中→遅の流れを保っている。
generatedData.flowDescription: まずmind_mapで人生に関わるあらゆる要素を発散させて視覚化し、多角的に関連付ける。次にcard_sortingでその要素をカテゴリごとに整理し、情報の構造を作る。次の収束段階ではpriority_slider_gridを用いて各要素の重要度を定量化し、優先順位を明確にする。最後にstructured_summaryでその結果をわかりやすくまとめ、今後の具体的な行動計画へつなげる。

# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "副業を始めたいが、何から手をつければいいか分からない。アイデアはいくつかあるが整理できていない"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to 副業を始めたいが、何から手をつければいいか分からない。アイデアはいくつかあるが整理できていない", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- mind_map_0.nodes → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- card_sorting_0.categories → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- card_sorting_0.uncategorized → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

# Input Context

## User Concern
副業を始めたいが、何から手をつければいいか分からない。アイデアはいくつかあるが整理できていない

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. mind_map - 副業アイデアを中心トピックから広げて関連情報や手段を発散させるため
Purpose: 発散し、多様な副業アイデアと関連情報を洗い出す
Target: 副業に関する未整理なアイデアや情報
Ports:
mind_map (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: centralTopic (string)
  OUT: nodes (object[])
  OUT: connections (object[])
  OUT: depth (number)

### Organize Section
1. card_sorting - 発散したアイデアを類似やテーマ別に分類して情報構造を整えるため
Purpose: 分類・整理によりアイデア群の全体像を把握する
Target: 発散フェーズで生成された副業アイデアと関連情報
Ports:
card_sorting (complexity: 0.4):
  IN: cards (object[])
  OUT: categories (object)
  OUT: uncategorized (object[])

### Converge Section
1. priority_slider_grid - 分類したアイデアの中から実行優先度を客観的に決定するため
Purpose: 実現性や効果の高いアイデアを選定する
Target: 整理されたアイデア群
Ports:
priority_slider_grid (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: items (object[])
  OUT: priorities (object[])
  OUT: ranking (string[])

## Widget Definitions (with generationHints - IMPORTANT)

    {

      "complexity": 0.4,

          "id": "cards",

      ],

        {

        }
      ]

## ORS Data Structure
{
  "version": "5.0",
  "planMetadata": {
    "concernText": "副業を始めたいが、何から手をつければいいか分からない。アイデアはいくつかあるが整理できていない",

        {

          "description": "ユーザーの元の悩みテキスト"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "dependencyGraph": {
    "dependencies": [],

    }
  },

    "bottleneckType": "information",
    "sections": [
      "diverge",
      "organize",
      "converge"
    ]
  }
}

# Output JSON Structure

Generate valid JSON with:
- version: "5.0"
- sessionId: "batch-772ca8db-4545-405b-a707-4bc221153420-151"
- stage: "plan"
- sections: { diverge, organize, converge } - each with header and widgets array
- reactiveBindings: { bindings: [...] } - widget connections (REQUIRED when enableReactivity=true)
- layout: { type: "sectioned", sectionGap: 24, sectionOrder: ["diverge", "organize", "converge"] }

## Widget Structure
{
  "id": "widgetType_sectionIndex" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0"),
  "component": "widgetType",
  "position": 0,
  "layout": "full",
  "config": { /* include generatedValue here if widget has generationHints */ },
  "dataBindings": [{ "portId": "...", "entityAttribute": "entity.attribute", "direction": "in|out" }],
  "metadata": { "purpose": "..." }
}

# Rules Reference

## updateMode Selection
- "realtime": Both widgets have complexity <= 0.3
- "debounced" (300ms): Either widget has complexity > 0.3

## relationship.type Selection
- "passthrough": Same data structure (e.g., cards → cards)
- "javascript": Need transformation (e.g., categories → items)

trialLogs.promptData:
# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "プロジェクトのタスクを洗い出した。これを時系列に並べて計画を立てたい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to プロジェクトのタスクを洗い出した。これを時系列に並べて計画を立てたい", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- mind_map_0.nodes → dependency_mapping_0.nodes (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → dependency_mapping_0.nodes (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → dependency_mapping_0.nodes (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.nodes → timeline_slider_1.events (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → timeline_slider_1.events (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → timeline_slider_1.events (diverge→organize)
- dependency_mapping_0.edges → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- dependency_mapping_0.criticalPath → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- dependency_mapping_0.hasLoop → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- timeline_slider_1.timeline → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- timeline_slider_1.currentPosition → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

# Input Context

## User Concern
プロジェクトのタスクを洗い出した。これを時系列に並べて計画を立てたい

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. mind_map - プロジェクトタスクの全体像と関連性を発散的に可視化し、時系列整理の前段として思考を広げる
Purpose: 発散的にタスクを広げ、関連付けやサブタスクの関係を明らかにする
Target: プロジェクトタスクの構造と関係性
Ports:
mind_map (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: centralTopic (string)
  OUT: nodes (object[])
  OUT: connections (object[])
  OUT: depth (number)

### Organize Section
1. dependency_mapping - 発散されたタスクの順序・依存関係を構造化し、時系列計画の基盤を作る
2. timeline_slider - 依存関係を整理したタスクを時系列に沿って並べ、スケジュール案を構築する
Purpose: 順序関係と時間軸配置を行い、計画構造を確定する
Target: タスクの依存関係と実行順序
Ports:
dependency_mapping (complexity: 0.7):
  IN: nodes (object[])
  OUT: edges (object[])
  OUT: criticalPath (string[])
  OUT: hasLoop (boolean)

timeline_slider (complexity: 0.4):
  IN: events (object[])
  OUT: timeline (object[])
  OUT: currentPosition (number)

### Converge Section
1. priority_slider_grid - 計画において重要度の高いタスクを選定・優先順位付けし、リソース配分に反映する
Purpose: 優先度を設定し、計画の実行順や重点領域を明確化する
Target: タスク優先順位
Ports:
priority_slider_grid (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: items (object[])
  OUT: priorities (object[])
  OUT: ranking (string[])

# Output JSON Structure

Generate valid JSON with:
- version: "5.0"
- sessionId: "batch-772ca8db-4545-405b-a707-4bc221153420-156"
- stage: "plan"
- sections: { diverge, organize, converge } - each with header and widgets array
- reactiveBindings: { bindings: [...] } - widget connections (REQUIRED when enableReactivity=true)
- layout: { type: "sectioned", sectionGap: 24, sectionOrder: ["diverge", "organize", "converge"] }

## Widget Structure
{
  "id": "widgetType_sectionIndex" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0"),
  "component": "widgetType",
  "position": 0,
  "layout": "full",
  "config": { /* include generatedValue here if widget has generationHints */ },
  "dataBindings": [{ "portId": "...", "entityAttribute": "entity.attribute", "direction": "in|out" }],
  "metadata": { "purpose": "..." }
}

# Rules Reference

## updateMode Selection
- "realtime": Both widgets have complexity <= 0.3
- "debounced" (300ms): Either widget has complexity > 0.3

## relationship.type Selection
- "passthrough": Same data structure (e.g., cards → cards)
- "javascript": Need transformation (e.g., categories → items)

# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "最近なんかモヤモヤしてて気持ちが晴れない"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
[ ] emotion_palette: config.emotions (labels, 8 items)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to 最近なんかモヤモヤしてて気持ちが晴れない", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- emotion_palette_0.selectedEmotions → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- emotion_palette_0.dominantEmotion → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- card_sorting_0.categories → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- card_sorting_0.uncategorized → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

# Input Context

## User Concern
最近なんかモヤモヤしてて気持ちが晴れない

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. emotion_palette - ユーザーの現在の感情を可視化し、強度を把握することでモヤモヤの原因を探る。
Purpose: 感情の洗い出しと現状把握
Target: 曖昧な気持ちやモヤモヤ感の具体化
Ports:
emotion_palette (complexity: 0.3):

  OUT: selectedEmotions (object[])
  OUT: dominantEmotion (string)
  GENERATE: config.emotions

### Organize Section
1. card_sorting - 発散フェーズで抽出した感情をカテゴリ別に整理し構造化する。
Purpose: 感情の分類と構造化
Target: 似た性質や原因の感情グループを把握
Ports:
card_sorting (complexity: 0.4):
  IN: cards (object[])
  OUT: categories (object)
  OUT: uncategorized (object[])

### Converge Section
1. priority_slider_grid - 整理された感情の中で、改善すべき優先順位を決定する。
Purpose: 重要度の高い感情や課題の特定
Target: 最も影響力の大きい感情や問題の優先順位化
Ports:
priority_slider_grid (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: items (object[])
  OUT: priorities (object[])
  OUT: ranking (string[])

## Widget Definitions (with generationHints - IMPORTANT)
{
  "diverge": [
    {
      "id": "emotion_palette",
      "name": "感情パレット",
      "description": "感情をカラーパレットから選択し、強度を調整する。",
      "complexity": 0.3,
      "inputs": [],

        {

          "count": 8,
          "schema": {
            "id": "string (emotion_1, emotion_2, ...)",
            "label": "string (日本語、2-4文字、例: 不安、焦り、期待)",
            "color": "string (hex color, e.g., #FF6B6B)",
            "category": "string (positive|negative|neutral)",
            "description": "string (日本語、感情の説明、5-15文字)"
          }
        }
      }
    }
  ],
  "organize": [
    {
      "id": "card_sorting",

      "complexity": 0.4,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "cards",

          "description": "ソートするカードリスト",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "categories",

          "description": "カテゴリごとのカード配置"
        },
        {
          "id": "uncategorized",

          "description": "未分類のカード"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "converge": [
    {
      "id": "priority_slider_grid",
      "name": "優先度スライダー",
      "description": "複数の項目に対してスライダーで優先度を設定。",
      "complexity": 0.3,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "items",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "優先度を設定する項目リスト",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "priorities",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "優先度情報 {id: string, label: string, priority: number}"
        },
        {
          "id": "ranking",
          "dataType": "string[]",
          "description": "優先度順のID配列"
        }
      ]

# Output JSON Structure

Generate valid JSON with:
- version: "5.0"
- sessionId: "batch-772ca8db-4545-405b-a707-4bc221153420-158"
- stage: "plan"
- sections: { diverge, organize, converge } - each with header and widgets array
- reactiveBindings: { bindings: [...] } - widget connections (REQUIRED when enableReactivity=true)
- layout: { type: "sectioned", sectionGap: 24, sectionOrder: ["diverge", "organize", "converge"] }

## Widget Structure
{
  "id": "widgetType_sectionIndex" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0"),
  "component": "widgetType",
  "position": 0,
  "layout": "full",
  "config": { /* include generatedValue here if widget has generationHints */ },
  "dataBindings": [{ "portId": "...", "entityAttribute": "entity.attribute", "direction": "in|out" }],

}

## updateMode Selection
- "realtime": Both widgets have complexity <= 0.3
- "debounced" (300ms): Either widget has complexity > 0.3

- "passthrough": Same data structure (e.g., cards → cards)
- "javascript": Need transformation (e.g., categories → items)

- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [

    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:

  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },

  ]
}

- question_card_chain_0.completedCount → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- card_sorting_0.categories → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- card_sorting_0.uncategorized → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):

  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

友人関係を見直したい。誰と付き合いを続けるか、距離を置くか、整理して優先度つけたい

question_card_chain (complexity: 0.3):

  OUT: answers (object[])
  OUT: completedCount (number)

### Organize Section

Purpose: 各友人関係を分類して、意思決定のための構造を作る
Target: 友人関係の分類

card_sorting (complexity: 0.4):

  OUT: categories (object)

You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "独立・起業を考えてるんだけど、準備すべきことが多すぎて整理できてない。資金、スキル、人脈、事業計画、いろいろあるけど何から手をつければいいか。時系列で整理して、いつまでに何をすべきか明確にしたい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [

    ],

  }
}

  ]
}

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- mind_map_0.nodes → dependency_mapping_0.nodes (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → dependency_mapping_0.nodes (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → dependency_mapping_0.nodes (diverge→organize)
- dependency_mapping_0.edges → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- dependency_mapping_0.criticalPath → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "資格試験の勉強範囲が広すぎる。まず全体像を把握してから、分野ごとに整理したい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to 資格試験の勉強範囲が広すぎる。まず全体像を把握してから、分野ごとに整理したい", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- mind_map_0.nodes → timeline_slider_0.events (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → timeline_slider_0.events (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → timeline_slider_0.events (diverge→organize)
- timeline_slider_0.timeline → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- timeline_slider_0.currentPosition → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

# Input Context

## User Concern
資格試験の勉強範囲が広すぎる。まず全体像を把握してから、分野ごとに整理したい

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. mind_map - 資格試験の広範な範囲を視覚的に全体像として把握するため
Purpose: 試験範囲全体の俯瞰と主要構造の洗い出し
Target: 資格試験全体の構成要素を網羅的に抽出
Ports:
mind_map (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: centralTopic (string)
  OUT: nodes (object[])
  OUT: connections (object[])
  OUT: depth (number)

### Organize Section
1. timeline_slider - 抽出した試験範囲を学習スケジュールとして整理するため
Purpose: 試験範囲と学習項目を順序立てて整理する
Target: 発散フェーズで抽出した試験項目の学習順序・スケジュール化
Ports:
timeline_slider (complexity: 0.4):
  IN: events (object[])
  OUT: timeline (object[])
  OUT: currentPosition (number)

### Converge Section
1. priority_slider_grid - 整理された学習項目の中で優先度を決めるため
Purpose: 重要度・緊急度に基づく優先順位付け
Target: 各分野・項目の学習優先度
Ports:
priority_slider_grid (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: items (object[])
  OUT: priorities (object[])
  OUT: ranking (string[])

## Widget Definitions (with generationHints - IMPORTANT)

      "complexity": 0.4,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "events",

        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {

        },

# Output JSON Structure

Generate valid JSON with:
- version: "5.0"
- sessionId: "batch-772ca8db-4545-405b-a707-4bc221153420-168"
- stage: "plan"
- sections: { diverge, organize, converge } - each with header and widgets array

# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "チームメンバーの不満を聞いてるんだけど、誰が何に不満持ってるか整理できてない。まとめて対策考えたい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to チームメンバーの不満を聞いてるんだけど、誰が何に不満持ってるか整理できてない。まとめて対策考えたい", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- mind_map_0.nodes → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- card_sorting_0.categories → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- card_sorting_0.uncategorized → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

# Input Context

## User Concern
チームメンバーの不満を聞いてるんだけど、誰が何に不満持ってるか整理できてない。まとめて対策考えたい

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. mind_map - 誰が何に不満を持っているのかを中心テーマから関連付けて洗い出すため
Purpose: チーム内の不満点を幅広く探索する
Target: メンバーごとの不満要素
Ports:
mind_map (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: centralTopic (string)
  OUT: nodes (object[])
  OUT: connections (object[])
  OUT: depth (number)

### Organize Section
1. card_sorting - メンバーごとの不満をカテゴリー別に整理するため
Purpose: 収集した不満情報を構造的に分類する
Target: 不満の種類別カテゴリ
Ports:
card_sorting (complexity: 0.4):
  IN: cards (object[])
  OUT: categories (object)
  OUT: uncategorized (object[])

### Converge Section
1. priority_slider_grid - 分類された不満カテゴリを優先度付けして対策順を決めるため
Purpose: 解決すべき不満の優先順位を決定する
Target: 不満カテゴリの優先度
Ports:
priority_slider_grid (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: items (object[])
  OUT: priorities (object[])
  OUT: ranking (string[])

## Widget Definitions (with generationHints - IMPORTANT)
{
  "diverge": [
    {
      "id": "mind_map",
      "name": "マインドマップ",
      "description": "中心トピックから放射状にアイデアを展開。",
      "complexity": 0.5,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "centralTopic",
          "dataType": "string",
          "description": "中心トピック",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "nodes",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "マインドマップのノード"
        },
        {
          "id": "connections",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "ノード間の接続"
        },
        {
          "id": "depth",
          "dataType": "number",
          "description": "最大の深さ"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "organize": [
    {
      "id": "card_sorting",
      "name": "カードソート",
      "description": "カードをカテゴリにドラッグ&ドロップで分類。",
      "complexity": 0.4,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "cards",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "ソートするカードリスト",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "categories",
          "dataType": "object",
          "description": "カテゴリごとのカード配置"
        },
        {
          "id": "uncategorized",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "未分類のカード"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "converge": [
    {
      "id": "priority_slider_grid",
      "name": "優先度スライダー",
      "description": "複数の項目に対してスライダーで優先度を設定。",
      "complexity": 0.3,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "items",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "優先度を設定する項目リスト",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "priorities",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "優先度情報 {id: string, label: string, priority: number}"
        },
        {
          "id": "ranking",
          "dataType": "string[]",
          "description": "優先度順のID配列"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}

## ORS Data Structure
{
  "version": "5.0",
  "planMetadata": {
    "concernText": "チームメンバーの不満を聞いてるんだけど、誰が何に不満持ってるか整理できてない。まとめて対策考えたい",
    "bottleneckType": "thought",
    "sections": [
      "diverge",
      "organize",
      "converge"
    ]
  },
  "entities": [
    {
      "id": "concern",
      "type": "concern",
      "attributes": [
        {
          "name": "text",
          "structuralType": "SVAL",
          "valueType": "string",
          "description": "ユーザーの元の悩みテキスト"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "dependencyGraph": {
    "dependencies": [],
    "metadata": {
      "version": "5.0",
      "generatedAt": 1765624513752
    }
  },
  "metadata": {
    "generatedAt": 1765624513752,
    "llmModel": "fallback",
    "sessionId": "batch-772ca8db-4545-405b-a707-4bc221153420-171",
    "concernText": "チームメンバーの不満を聞いてるんだけど、誰が何に不満持ってるか整理できてない。まとめて対策考えたい",
    "bottleneckType": "thought",
    "sections": [
      "diverge",
      "organize",
      "converge"
    ]
  }
}

# Output JSON Structure

Generate valid JSON with:
- version: "5.0"
- sessionId: "batch-772ca8db-4545-405b-a707-4bc221153420-171"
- stage: "plan"
- sections: { diverge, organize, converge } - each with header and widgets array
- reactiveBindings: { bindings: [...] } - widget connections (REQUIRED when enableReactivity=true)
- layout: { type: "sectioned", sectionGap: 24, sectionOrder: ["diverge", "organize", "converge"] }

## Widget Structure
{
  "id": "widgetType_sectionIndex" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0"),
  "component": "widgetType",
  "position": 0,
  "layout": "full",
  "config": { /* include generatedValue here if widget has generationHints */ },
  "dataBindings": [{ "portId": "...", "entityAttribute": "entity.attribute", "direction": "in|out" }],
  "metadata": { "purpose": "..." }
}

# Rules Reference

## updateMode Selection
- "realtime": Both widgets have complexity <= 0.3
- "debounced" (300ms): Either widget has complexity > 0.3

## relationship.type Selection
- "passthrough": Same data structure (e.g., cards → cards)
- "javascript": Need transformation (e.g., categories → items)

# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "今後の人生設計を考えたい。仕事、家庭、趣味、健康、いろんな要素があるけど全部大事で、何を優先すべきかわからない。まずは自分にとって大切なことを全部書き出して、整理してから優先順位をつけたい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to 今後の人生設計を考えたい。仕事、家庭、趣味、健康、いろんな要素があるけど全部大事で、何を優先すべきかわからない。まずは自分にとって大切なことを全部書き出して、整理してから優先順位をつけたい", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- mind_map_0.nodes → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- card_sorting_0.categories → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- card_sorting_0.uncategorized → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

# Input Context

## User Concern
今後の人生設計を考えたい。仕事、家庭、趣味、健康、いろんな要素があるけど全部大事で、何を優先すべきかわからない。まずは自分にとって大切なことを全部書き出して、整理してから優先順位をつけたい

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. mind_map - 人生の重要な要素（仕事、家庭、趣味、健康など）を中心に広げて関連付けを可視化し、全体像を把握するため
Purpose: 発散して考えを広げ、人生における重要な要素を網羅的に洗い出す
Target: ユーザーが大事だと考える要素の収集と関連性の把握
Ports:
mind_map (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: centralTopic (string)
  OUT: nodes (object[])
  OUT: connections (object[])
  OUT: depth (number)

### Organize Section
1. card_sorting - 発散して得た要素を分野やテーマごとに分類し、混乱を減らすため
Purpose: 分類し構造化して、重要要素のリストを整理する
Target: マインドマップで抽出された項目のカテゴリ分け
Ports:
card_sorting (complexity: 0.4):
  IN: cards (object[])
  OUT: categories (object)

# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "今日やることをタイムラインに並べて効率よく進めたい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to 今日やることをタイムラインに並べて効率よく進めたい", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:

  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- mind_map_0.nodes → dependency_mapping_0.nodes (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → dependency_mapping_0.nodes (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → dependency_mapping_0.nodes (diverge→organize)

- mind_map_0.connections → timeline_slider_1.events (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → timeline_slider_1.events (diverge→organize)
- dependency_mapping_0.edges → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- dependency_mapping_0.criticalPath → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- dependency_mapping_0.hasLoop → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- timeline_slider_1.timeline → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

  },

}
