trialLogs.promptData:
# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "買いたいものがいっぱいあるけど予算に限りがある。優先度つけて計画的に買いたい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to 買いたいものがいっぱいあるけど予算に限りがある。優先度つけて計画的に買いたい", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- mind_map_0.nodes → matrix_placement_0.items (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.nodes → matrix_placement_0.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → matrix_placement_0.items (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → matrix_placement_0.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → matrix_placement_0.items (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → matrix_placement_0.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- matrix_placement_0.placements → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- matrix_placement_0.quadrantCounts → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

# Input Context

## User Concern
買いたいものがいっぱいあるけど予算に限りがある。優先度つけて計画的に買いたい

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. mind_map - 購入したいものや要素を関連付けしながら広げて、予算・欲求・計画に関する思考を発散させるため
Purpose: 購入予定に関する全てのアイデアや要素を幅広く抽出する
Target: 欲しいものや関連する条件・制約の洗い出し
Ports:
mind_map (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: centralTopic (string)
  OUT: nodes (object[])
  OUT: connections (object[])
  OUT: depth (number)

### Organize Section
1. matrix_placement - 予算内での優先順位付けや評価軸に沿った整理を行うため
Purpose: 発散したアイデアを重要度や価格などの軸で整理する
Target: 価格と必要性を判断基準としたアイテム整理
Ports:
matrix_placement (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: items (object[])
  IN: axisLabels (object)
  OUT: placements (object[])
  OUT: quadrantCounts (object)

### Converge Section
1. priority_slider_grid - 整理したアイテムの優先度を数値化し、購入順序を決定するため
Purpose: 最も効果的に予算を使うための購入優先順位の決定
Target: 購入計画に基づく優先度設定
Ports:
priority_slider_grid (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: items (object[])
  OUT: priorities (object[])
  OUT: ranking (string[])

## Widget Definitions (with generationHints - IMPORTANT)
{
  "diverge": [
    {
      "id": "mind_map",
      "name": "マインドマップ",
      "description": "中心トピックから放射状にアイデアを展開。",
      "complexity": 0.5,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "centralTopic",
          "dataType": "string",
          "description": "中心トピック",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "nodes",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "マインドマップのノード"
        },
        {
          "id": "connections",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "ノード間の接続"
        },
        {
          "id": "depth",
          "dataType": "number",
          "description": "最大の深さ"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "organize": [
    {
      "id": "matrix_placement",
      "name": "マトリクス配置",
      "description": "2軸のマトリクス上にアイテムを配置し、位置関係を可視化。",
      "complexity": 0.5,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "items",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "配置するアイテムリスト",
          "required": false
        },
        {
          "id": "axisLabels",
          "dataType": "object",
          "description": "軸のラベル {xAxis: {low: string, high: string}, yAxis: {low: string, high: string}}",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "placements",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "アイテムの配置情報 {id: string, x: number, y: number}"
        },
        {
          "id": "quadrantCounts",
          "dataType": "object",
          "description": "各象限のアイテム数"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "converge": [
    {
      "id": "priority_slider_grid",
      "name": "優先度スライダー",
      "description": "複数の項目に対してスライダーで優先度を設定。",
      "complexity": 0.3,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "items",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "優先度を設定する項目リスト",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "priorities",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "優先度情報 {id: string, label: string, priority: number}"
        },
        {
          "id": "ranking",
          "dataType": "string[]",
          "description": "優先度順のID配列"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}

## ORS Data Structure
{
  "version": "5.0",
  "planMetadata": {
    "concernText": "買いたいものがいっぱいあるけど予算に限りがある。優先度つけて計画的に買いたい",
    "bottleneckType": "thought",
    "sections": [
      "diverge",
      "organize",
      "converge"
    ]
  },
  "entities": [
    {
      "id": "concern",
      "type": "concern",
      "attributes": [
        {
          "name": "text",
          "structuralType": "SVAL",
          "valueType": "string",
          "description": "ユーザーの元の悩みテキスト"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "dependencyGraph": {
    "dependencies": [],
    "metadata": {
      "version": "5.0",
      "generatedAt": 1765624753811
    }
  },
  "metadata": {
    "generatedAt": 1765624753811,
    "llmModel": "fallback",
    "sessionId": "batch-772ca8db-4545-405b-a707-4bc221153420-179",
    "concernText": "買いたいものがいっぱいあるけど予算に限りがある。優先度つけて計画的に買いたい",
    "bottleneckType": "thought",
    "sections": [
      "diverge",
      "organize",
      "converge"
    ]
  }
}

# Output JSON Structure

Generate valid JSON with:
- version: "5.0"
- sessionId: "batch-772ca8db-4545-405b-a707-4bc221153420-179"
- stage: "plan"
- sections: { diverge, organize, converge } - each with header and widgets array
- reactiveBindings: { bindings: [...] } - widget connections (REQUIRED when enableReactivity=true)
- layout: { type: "sectioned", sectionGap: 24, sectionOrder: ["diverge", "organize", "converge"] }

## Widget Structure
{
  "id": "widgetType_sectionIndex" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0"),
  "component": "widgetType",
  "position": 0,
  "layout": "full",
  "config": { /* include generatedValue here if widget has generationHints */ },
  "dataBindings": [{ "portId": "...", "entityAttribute": "entity.attribute", "direction": "in|out" }],
  "metadata": { "purpose": "..." }
}

# Rules Reference

## updateMode Selection
- "realtime": Both widgets have complexity <= 0.3
- "debounced" (300ms): Either widget has complexity > 0.3

## relationship.type Selection
- "passthrough": Same data structure (e.g., cards → cards)
- "javascript": Need transformation (e.g., categories → items)

trialLogs.promptData:
# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "人生の大きな決断を控えてる。結婚、転職、引越し、全部同時に考えないといけない。まず全体像を整理して、それぞれの選択肢のメリデメを比較して、最終的にどう進むべきか優先順位をつけたい。複雑すぎて頭がパンクしそうだけど、一度きちんと整理したい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to 人生の大きな決断を控えてる。結婚、転職、引越し、全部同時に考えないといけない。まず全体像を整理して、それぞれの選択肢のメリデメを比較して、最終的にどう進むべきか優先順位をつけたい。複雑すぎて頭がパンクしそうだけど、一度きちんと整理したい", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- mind_map_0.nodes → timeline_slider_0.events (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → timeline_slider_0.events (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → timeline_slider_0.events (diverge→organize)
- timeline_slider_0.timeline → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- timeline_slider_0.currentPosition → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

# Input Context

## User Concern
人生の大きな決断を控えてる。結婚、転職、引越し、全部同時に考えないといけない。まず全体像を整理して、それぞれの選択肢のメリデメを比較して、最終的にどう進むべきか優先順位をつけたい。複雑すぎて頭がパンクしそうだけど、一度きちんと整理したい

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. mind_map - 人生の大きな決断に関する全体像を放射状に展開し、複数要素間の関連を視覚化することで情報を漏れなく収集する
Purpose: 複雑な意思決定要素を俯瞰して、全体像を可視化し抜け漏れをなくす
Target: 結婚・転職・引越しの選択肢や関連要素、背景条件
Ports:
mind_map (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: centralTopic (string)
  OUT: nodes (object[])
  OUT: connections (object[])
  OUT: depth (number)

trialLogs.promptData:
# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "資格取得の勉強計画を立てたい。範囲を洗い出して、依存関係を整理して、時系列で計画を立てたい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to 資格取得の勉強計画を立てたい。範囲を洗い出して、依存関係を整理して、時系列で計画を立てたい", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- mind_map_0.nodes → dependency_mapping_0.nodes (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → dependency_mapping_0.nodes (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → dependency_mapping_0.nodes (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.nodes → timeline_slider_1.events (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → timeline_slider_1.events (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → timeline_slider_1.events (diverge→organize)
- dependency_mapping_0.edges → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- dependency_mapping_0.criticalPath → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- dependency_mapping_0.hasLoop → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- timeline_slider_1.timeline → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- timeline_slider_1.currentPosition → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

trialLogs.promptData:
# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "最近なんかモヤモヤしてて気持ちが晴れない"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
[ ] emotion_palette: config.emotions (labels, 8 items)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to 最近なんかモヤモヤしてて気持ちが晴れない", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- emotion_palette_0.selectedEmotions → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- emotion_palette_0.dominantEmotion → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- card_sorting_0.categories → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- card_sorting_0.uncategorized → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

# Input Context

## User Concern
最近なんかモヤモヤしてて気持ちが晴れない

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. emotion_palette - 感情を可視化し、モヤモヤの原因を探るため
Purpose: 感情や気持ちを広げ、認識する
Target: ユーザーが感じているモヤモヤを具体的に明らかにする
Ports:
emotion_palette (complexity: 0.3):

  OUT: selectedEmotions (object[])
  OUT: dominantEmotion (string)
  GENERATE: config.emotions

### Organize Section
1. card_sorting - 感情や気持ちをカテゴリーに分けて整理するため
Purpose: モヤモヤを整理し、理解する
Target: 選択された感情を適切なカテゴリに分類する
Ports:
card_sorting (complexity: 0.4):
  IN: cards (object[])
  OUT: categories (object)
  OUT: uncategorized (object[])

### Converge Section
1. priority_slider_grid - 整理した感情の優先順位を設定するため
Purpose: 重要な感情を特定し、次のアクションを決定する
Target: 整理した感情を優先順位付けし、最も影響の大きいものを特定する
Ports:
priority_slider_grid (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: items (object[])
  OUT: priorities (object[])
  OUT: ranking (string[])

## Widget Definitions (with generationHints - IMPORTANT)
{
  "diverge": [
    {
      "id": "emotion_palette",
      "name": "感情パレット",
      "description": "感情をカラーパレットから選択し、強度を調整する。",
      "complexity": 0.3,
      "inputs": [],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "selectedEmotions",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "選択された感情リスト {emotion: string, intensity: number}"
        },
        {
          "id": "dominantEmotion",
          "dataType": "string",
          "description": "最も強い感情"
        }
      ],
      "generationHints": {
        "labels": {
          "field": "emotions",
          "instruction": "ユーザーの悩みの状況で抱きがちな感情を8個生成してください。各感情には適切な色（暖色＝ポジティブ、寒色＝ネガティブなど）を設定してください。",
          "count": 8,
          "schema": {
            "id": "string (emotion_1, emotion_2, ...)",
            "label": "string (日本語、2-4文字、例: 不安、焦り、期待)",
            "color": "string (hex color, e.g., #FF6B6B)",
            "category": "string (positive|negative|neutral)",
            "description": "string (日本語、感情の説明、5-15文字)"
          }
        }
      }
    }
  ],
  "organize": [
    {
      "id": "card_sorting",
      "name": "カードソート",
      "description": "カードをカテゴリにドラッグ&ドロップで分類。",
      "complexity": 0.4,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "cards",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "ソートするカードリスト",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "categories",
          "dataType": "object",
          "description": "カテゴリごとのカード配置"
        },
        {
          "id": "uncategorized",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "未分類のカード"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "converge": [
    {
      "id": "priority_slider_grid",
      "name": "優先度スライダー",
      "description": "複数の項目に対してスライダーで優先度を設定。",
      "complexity": 0.3,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "items",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "優先度を設定する項目リスト",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "priorities",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "優先度情報 {id: string, label: string, priority: number}"
        },
        {
          "id": "ranking",
          "dataType": "string[]",
          "description": "優先度順のID配列"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}

## ORS Data Structure
{
  "version": "5.0",
  "planMetadata": {
    "concernText": "最近なんかモヤモヤしてて気持ちが晴れない",
    "bottleneckType": "emotional",
    "sections": [
      "diverge",
      "organize",
      "converge"
    ]
  },
  "entities": [
    {
      "id": "concern",
      "type": "concern",
      "attributes": [
        {
          "name": "text",
          "structuralType": "SVAL",
          "valueType": "string",
          "description": "ユーザーの元の悩みテキスト"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "dependencyGraph": {
    "dependencies": [],
    "metadata": {
      "version": "5.0",
      "generatedAt": 1765625510837
    }
  },
  "metadata": {
    "generatedAt": 1765625510837,
    "llmModel": "fallback",
    "sessionId": "batch-772ca8db-4545-405b-a707-4bc221153420-208",
    "concernText": "最近なんかモヤモヤしてて気持ちが晴れない",
    "bottleneckType": "emotional",
    "sections": [
      "diverge",
      "organize",
      "converge"
    ]
  }
}

# Output JSON Structure

Generate valid JSON with:
- version: "5.0"
- sessionId: "batch-772ca8db-4545-405b-a707-4bc221153420-208"
- stage: "plan"
- sections: { diverge, organize, converge } - each with header and widgets array
- reactiveBindings: { bindings: [...] } - widget connections (REQUIRED when enableReactivity=true)
- layout: { type: "sectioned", sectionGap: 24, sectionOrder: ["diverge", "organize", "converge"] }

## Widget Structure
{
  "id": "widgetType_sectionIndex" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0"),
  "component": "widgetType",
  "position": 0,
  "layout": "full",
  "config": { /* include generatedValue here if widget has generationHints */ },
  "dataBindings": [{ "portId": "...", "entityAttribute": "entity.attribute", "direction": "in|out" }],
  "metadata": { "purpose": "..." }
}

# Rules Reference

## updateMode Selection
- "realtime": Both widgets have complexity <= 0.3
- "debounced" (300ms): Either widget has complexity > 0.3

## relationship.type Selection
- "passthrough": Same data structure (e.g., cards → cards)
- "javascript": Need transformation (e.g., categories → items)

trialLogs.promptData:
# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "会議で出たアイデアをまとめて優先度つけたい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
[ ] brainstorm_cards: config.sampleCards (samples, 2-3 items)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to 会議で出たアイデアをまとめて優先度つけたい", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- brainstorm_cards_0.cards → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- brainstorm_cards_0.cardCount → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- brainstorm_cards_0.cards → matrix_placement_1.items (diverge→organize)
- brainstorm_cards_0.cards → matrix_placement_1.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- brainstorm_cards_0.cardCount → matrix_placement_1.items (diverge→organize)
- brainstorm_cards_0.cardCount → matrix_placement_1.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_1.nodes → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_1.connections → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_1.depth → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_1.nodes → matrix_placement_1.items (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_1.nodes → matrix_placement_1.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_1.connections → matrix_placement_1.items (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_1.connections → matrix_placement_1.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_1.depth → matrix_placement_1.items (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_1.depth → matrix_placement_1.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- card_sorting_0.categories → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- card_sorting_0.uncategorized → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- matrix_placement_1.placements → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- matrix_placement_1.quadrantCounts → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

# Input Context

## User Concern
会議で出たアイデアをまとめて優先度つけたい

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. brainstorm_cards - 会議で出たアイデアを自由に追加し、視覚的に整理して発散させるため。
2. mind_map - 中心からアイデアを放射状に広げ、関連性を明確にするため。
Purpose: アイデアを広げて収集する
Target: 会議で出たアイデア
Ports:
brainstorm_cards (complexity: 0.2):

  OUT: cards (object[])
  OUT: cardCount (number)
  GENERATE: config.sampleCards

mind_map (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: centralTopic (string)
  OUT: nodes (object[])
  OUT: connections (object[])
  OUT: depth (number)

### Organize Section
1. card_sorting - 集めたアイデアをカテゴリに分けて整理するため。
2. matrix_placement - アイデアを2軸で配置して、それぞれの優先順位を視覚的に示すため。
Purpose: アイデアを整理・構造化する
Target: 収集したアイデア
Ports:
card_sorting (complexity: 0.4):
  IN: cards (object[])
  OUT: categories (object)
  OUT: uncategorized (object[])

matrix_placement (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: items (object[])
  IN: axisLabels (object)
  OUT: placements (object[])
  OUT: quadrantCounts (object)

### Converge Section
1. priority_slider_grid - 各アイデアに対して優先度を設定し、最も重要なものを選定するため。
Purpose: アイデアの優先順位を決定する
Target: 優先順位をつけたアイデア
Ports:
priority_slider_grid (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: items (object[])
  OUT: priorities (object[])
  OUT: ranking (string[])

# Output JSON Structure

Generate valid JSON with:
- version: "5.0"
- sessionId: "batch-772ca8db-4545-405b-a707-4bc221153420-217"
- stage: "plan"
- sections: { diverge, organize, converge } - each with header and widgets array
- reactiveBindings: { bindings: [...] } - widget connections (REQUIRED when enableReactivity=true)
- layout: { type: "sectioned", sectionGap: 24, sectionOrder: ["diverge", "organize", "converge"] }

## Widget Structure
{
  "id": "widgetType_sectionIndex" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0"),
  "component": "widgetType",
  "position": 0,
  "layout": "full",
  "config": { /* include generatedValue here if widget has generationHints */ },
  "dataBindings": [{ "portId": "...", "entityAttribute": "entity.attribute", "direction": "in|out" }],
  "metadata": { "purpose": "..." }
}

# Rules Reference

## updateMode Selection
- "realtime": Both widgets have complexity <= 0.3
- "debounced" (300ms): Either widget has complexity > 0.3

## relationship.type Selection
- "passthrough": Same data structure (e.g., cards → cards)
- "javascript": Need transformation (e.g., categories → items)

trialLogs.promptData:
# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "友人関係を見直したい。誰と付き合いを続けるか、距離を置くか、整理して優先度つけたい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
[ ] emotion_palette: config.emotions (labels, 8 items)
[ ] brainstorm_cards: config.sampleCards (samples, 2-3 items)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to 友人関係を見直したい。誰と付き合いを続けるか、距離を置くか、整理して優先度つけたい", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- emotion_palette_0.selectedEmotions → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- emotion_palette_0.dominantEmotion → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- emotion_palette_0.selectedEmotions → matrix_placement_1.items (diverge→organize)
- emotion_palette_0.selectedEmotions → matrix_placement_1.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- emotion_palette_0.dominantEmotion → matrix_placement_1.items (diverge→organize)
- emotion_palette_0.dominantEmotion → matrix_placement_1.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- question_card_chain_1.answers → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- question_card_chain_1.completedCount → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- question_card_chain_1.answers → matrix_placement_1.items (diverge→organize)
- question_card_chain_1.answers → matrix_placement_1.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- question_card_chain_1.completedCount → matrix_placement_1.items (diverge→organize)
- question_card_chain_1.completedCount → matrix_placement_1.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- brainstorm_cards_2.cards → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- brainstorm_cards_2.cardCount → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- brainstorm_cards_2.cards → matrix_placement_1.items (diverge→organize)
- brainstorm_cards_2.cards → matrix_placement_1.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- brainstorm_cards_2.cardCount → matrix_placement_1.items (diverge→organize)
- brainstorm_cards_2.cardCount → matrix_placement_1.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- card_sorting_0.categories → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- card_sorting_0.uncategorized → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- matrix_placement_1.placements → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- matrix_placement_1.quadrantCounts → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

# Input Context

## User Concern
友人関係を見直したい。誰と付き合いを続けるか、距離を置くか、整理して優先度つけたい

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. emotion_palette - 感情を多様に洗い出すため
2. question_card_chain - 友人関係を見直すための質問を通じて思考を深める
3. brainstorm_cards - 友人関係についてのアイデアを自由に出す
Purpose: 感情やアイデアを広げ、多様な視点を持つ
Target: 友人に対する感情や考えを明確にする
Ports:
emotion_palette (complexity: 0.3):

  OUT: selectedEmotions (object[])
  OUT: dominantEmotion (string)
  GENERATE: config.emotions

question_card_chain (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: questions (string[])
  OUT: answers (object[])
  OUT: completedCount (number)

brainstorm_cards (complexity: 0.2):

  OUT: cards (object[])
  OUT: cardCount (number)
  GENERATE: config.sampleCards

### Organize Section
1. card_sorting - 友人関係をカテゴリに分類するため
2. matrix_placement - 友人との関係の優先度を視覚化するため
Purpose: 発散したアイデアや感情を整理し、視覚的に構造化する
Target: 友人との関係をクリアにするための整理
Ports:
card_sorting (complexity: 0.4):
  IN: cards (object[])
  OUT: categories (object)
  OUT: uncategorized (object[])

matrix_placement (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: items (object[])
  IN: axisLabels (object)
  OUT: placements (object[])
  OUT: quadrantCounts (object)

### Converge Section
1. priority_slider_grid - 友人との関係の優先度を明確にするため
Purpose: 優先すべき友人関係を決定する
Target: 整理した関係を基に優先順位を決める
Ports:
priority_slider_grid (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: items (object[])
  OUT: priorities (object[])
  OUT: ranking (string[])
